name: Crocodile
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
effect: [On Play] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card is a {The Seven Warlords of the Sea} type card, draw 2 cards and place 1 card from your hand at the top of your deck.

official_faq.question: If I use this [On Play] effect to reveal 1 card from the top of my deck, and that card is a {The Seven Warlords of the Sea} type card, what happens to the revealed card?
official_faq.answer: In this case, the revealed card will count as one of the 2 cards you draw from your deck, and then you will place 1 card from your hand at the top of your deck.

official_faq.question: If I use this [On Play] effect to reveal 1 card from the top of my deck, and that card is not a {The Seven Warlords of the Sea} type card, what happens?
official_faq.answer: In this case, the revealed card is returned face-down to the top of your deck.
